name: naive_baseline_all_features
summary: Fit the capability's default linear/regularized model on +all_allowed features as a calibration baseline.
rationale: Anchors the metric range and reveals trivially-leaky columns.

name: univariate_top3_champion
summary: Pick the 3 columns with highest univariate predictive strength from L1+L2 and fit a small model on them.
rationale: Tests whether a tiny feature set already captures most signal.

name: regime_specific_submodels
summary: When L3 reports >=2 regimes, train a per-regime submodel and score on out-of-regime data.
rationale: Surfaces non-stationary structure that a global model averages out.

name: interaction_augmented_baseline
summary: Add the top-5 interactions from L2 as engineered features to the baseline.
rationale: Tests whether the joint structure adds info beyond marginals.

name: leakage_probe
summary: Deliberately include a downstream/forbidden column to establish the empirical leakage ceiling.
rationale: Establishes a sanity ceiling: clean models should never come close to this.
